subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should `getPublishedDisplayManifest` become paginated or capped, be redesigned to avoid returning a complete catalog, or remain an explicitly documented exception?
rationale: The function intentionally constructs a complete GitHub-backed display manifest, so imposing a bound changes its consumer contract and cannot be safely inferred from the earlier staged optimization.

options.title: Redesign As Bounded
options.body: Introduce a paginated or explicitly capped manifest contract with read-bound, cursor, and completeness tests.

options.title: Document An Exception
options.body: Retain complete-manifest semantics while documenting an explicit scale limit and operational rationale.

options.title: Create Focused Follow-Up
options.body: Move the manifest contract decision to one canonical issue and keep this issue linked until that work is resolved.

recommendation.title: Redesign As Bounded
recommendation.body: Introduce a paginated or explicitly capped manifest contract with read-bound, cursor, and completeness tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the audit and partial implementation and recorded the unresolved product boundary.
